about: Modwerk site-owned package imported from elekloader/elekloader release v0.11.0: the Model:Cycles core for OS 1.13 by drumkilla, with the firmware locations (0.2) and ev_boot (0.3), built from mods/core-mc at f20ffda. Kit 0.7.0's web catalog does not list it. It is the release the Model:Cycles base started from (sdk/machines/model-cycles/elekloader/base.json, reference).
